comparator.name: Psychology (Psychologie)
comparator.academicYear: Adopted 2026–2027 psychology OER; concurrent prospective year overviews
comparator.sourceNotes: The adopted 2026–27 OER specifies 180 EC as three 60-EC years. It supersedes prospectus inconsistencies: the year-one page duplicates Dutch/English Psychodiagnostiek and labels the 6+6 EC professionalisation blocks as PPD; the OER counts the single 3-EC diagnostic course once. The year-three prospectus shows 60.5 EC and 0.5 EC Me & My Career, while the OER assigns Me and My Career 2 zero credit and defines the degree year as 60 EC. Years one and two comprise broad psychology, brain/cognition, development and mental health, behaviour/environment, statistics, psychometrics, projects and professional training; year two has one of three 6-EC domain choices. Year three has 12 EC in two domain courses (one must match the chosen domain), 4 EC domain-specific methods, 12 EC three domain electives, 4 EC psychological ethics, 16 EC genuine free electives and a 12-EC thesis. The generic target lacks a named domain; Brain & Cognition is the first OER-listed domain and is selected solely as an official-order tie-break, with the compatible 6-EC year-two domain choice and three genuine year-three electives. Concurrent prospective pages do not guarantee a fixed three-year entrant-cohort schedule.

alternatives.label: Psychology of cognition, development and behaviour
alternatives.concept: A broad evidence-based psychology curriculum studies brain and cognition, mental health across life, social interaction, psychodiagnostics, statistics and research. UCR covers the defining questions in several related disciplines but has fewer dedicated experimental laboratories and no Radboud domain-specific supervised thesis.
alternatives.labelReason: The completed courses span cognition, development, mental health, behaviour and empirical methods, so the label does not imply a single cognitive-neuroscience specialization.
progression: Introductory brain, biomedical, social and method courses precede formally dependent advanced courses; every assigned term is offered.

alternatives.label: Mental health, development and clinical assessment
alternatives.concept: A psychologically grounded route gives greater weight to psychopathology, developmental vulnerability, assessment, treatment, health psychology and population health; biomedical mechanisms and clinical ethics complement that focus without claiming a clinical qualification.
alternatives.labelReason: The full curriculum mixes developmental, clinical, public-health and research courses and does not imply professional registration.
progression: All formal brain and biomedical prerequisites are earlier; development and methods precede the advanced clinical work; assigned terms are offered.
alternatives.distinctness: The clinical path substitutes population health, pharmacology, biomedical disease mechanisms and healthcare ethics for communication, philosophy-of-mind and social-persuasion emphases in the broad route; this is a substantive change in what mental-health evidence and support students study.

alternatives.label: Social and organisational psychology
alternatives.concept: A social-behaviour route focuses on group processes, motivation, diversity, organisational leadership, persuasion and communication, grounded in psychology and empirical research; it explores workplace and educational settings without suggesting a professional psychology licence.
alternatives.labelReason: Psychology, sociology, leadership and communication appear throughout the completed schedule, so a combined label describes it more accurately than organisational psychology alone.
progression: Research Methods & Statistics precedes advanced leadership coursework; Introduction to Brain & Behavior precedes dependent psychology courses, and all terms are offered.
alternatives.distinctness: This path changes the upper-year curriculum toward organisational behaviour, leadership, diversity, social influence and applied communication rather than the broad cognitive and clinical/health sequences in the other routes.
traceOverrides: Examines agency, selfhood and free will as concepts behind psychological interpretations of action.

routeSelection.basis: The generic psychology target permits three equal domain choices. The adopted 2026–27 OER lists Brain & Cognition first; no official source establishes a more representative default. The selected year-two domain course, year-three domain course, applied methods and three 4-EC elective courses form one valid domain instance; 16 EC remains free.

selection.assessment: A broad psychological science programme and two distinct feasible clinical/developmental and social/organisational directions answer supported interest clusters. The narrower school and rehabilitation applications were assessed separately, and three is the maximum.

notes.text: UCR teaches psychology, cognition, biology, sociology, research and applied leadership, but does not reproduce Radboud’s three-domain structure, supervised professional skills sequence or domain-specific psychology thesis. Clinical courses do not amount to clinical training or qualification.
